event-study.alt: Two lines of the difference between districts that became aligned and districts that did not, relative to the year before each change, in percent of usual grants. Before both changes the lines run within about 20 % of zero. After November 2018: +70 % in the first year, about 0 in the second, +19 % in the third. After February 2023: −59 % in the first year; the next two years, dashed, −95 % and +46 %.
